description: Unit test class for the StatusInfo class in the health check utility, testing serialization, deserialization, status logic, and immutability.

classes.name: StatusInfoTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for StatusInfo, testing correctness and immutability.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that StatusInfo instances are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies hashCode and equals implementations of StatusInfo.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that toJson() produces expected JSON output.

methods.name: fromValidJsonString
methods.description: Tests creation of StatusInfo from a valid JSON string.

methods.name: fromValidJsonObject
methods.description: Tests creation of StatusInfo from a JsonObject.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Tests setting a label on StatusInfo.

methods.name: labelMayBeSetToNull
methods.description: Tests setting label to null in StatusInfo.

methods.name: fromDetailReturnsStatusDownWhenItIsAnErrorDetail
methods.description: Tests StatusInfo creation from error detail.

methods.name: fromDetailReturnsStatusUpWhenItIsAWarnDetail
methods.description: Tests StatusInfo creation from warning detail.

methods.name: fromDetailReturnsStatusUpWhenItIsAnInfoDetail
methods.description: Tests StatusInfo creation from info detail.

methods.name: fromDetailsReturnsStatusDownWhenThereIsAtLeastOneErrorDetail
methods.description: Tests StatusInfo creation from multiple details including errors.

methods.name: fromDetailsReturnsStatusUpWhenThereIsNoErrorDetail
methods.description: Tests StatusInfo creation when only non-error details.

methods.name: fromStatusCorrectlyMapsStatus
methods.description: Tests creation from a Status enumeration value.

methods.name: fromStatusWithMessageReturnsStatusUpWithInfoDetailWhenStatusIsUp
methods.description: Tests creation from status with an info message for UP.

methods.name: fromStatusWithMessageReturnsStatusDownWithErrorDetailWhenStatusIsDown
methods.description: Tests creation from status with an error message for DOWN.

methods.name: fromStatusWithMessageReturnsStatusUnknownWithInfoDetailWhenStatusIsUnknown
methods.description: Tests creation from status with an info message for UNKNOWN.

methods.name: unknownStatusReturnsStatusUnknown
methods.description: Tests that the 'unknown' StatusInfo returns the correct status.

methods.name: compositeReturnsStatusUpWhenAllChildrenAreUp
methods.description: Tests composite status calculation when all children are UP.

methods.name: compositeReturnsStatusUpWhenChildrenAreEmpty
methods.description: Tests composite status when there are no children.

methods.name: compositeReturnsStatusUpWhenAllChildrenAreUpAndOneIsUnknown

methods.name: compositeReturnsStatusDownWhenAtLeastOneChildIsDown
methods.description: Tests composite status with at least one DOWN child.

methods.name: mergeStatus
methods.description: Tests the merge logic between two Status status values.
